role: Development project boards, issue state/comments and scalar releases
known_patches: Issue index SQL quoting normalized in non-evidence columns, refs and seeds
Persona User id 1 is active administrator, matching EmailAddress
Existing issue-comment lookup exposes its owner/repo path args; close/reopen owner/repo schemas typed and required
Existing project_search adds optional q substring filter while preserving repository scope
Materialize declared Project.is_closed=false and Column.default=false/sorting=0 on existing create tools
limitations: No Repository/Issue/Comment/Column/Release read or list tools exist; tasks must supply ids, owner and repository names. Project reads expose the supported policy carrier.
issue_create uses a seed-reserved IssueIndex value without incrementing it; repeated creates cannot rely on unique indices.
issue_edit targets Comment and lacks its target issue-id argument; it fails rather than reliably updating Issue title/body. comment_edit updates IssueContentHistory, not the Comment.
projectissue_add creates membership; projectissue_move/remove append comments without moving/deleting ProjectIssue. project_delete does not delete Project.
Repository update/transfer, team membership, workflow/Git/file/package operations have mismapped or partial effects and are not capability claims.
issue_delete is verified for unreferenced issues only; existing comments block deletion and are not cascaded.
